Nina: Heads-up  customer wants a per-tenant ephemeral rollout (opt-in) with EU holdback, canary windows, A/B checks, and an instant kill-switch. Need owners for capacity, runtime, and runbook.

Omar: I can own capacity. Suggest region+tenant slices: start 1% tenants (eu-first) -> 5% -> 15% over 24-48h if green. Reserve 10% dedicated warm capacity for premium SKUs.

Zoe: Runtime: OK on slices. Recommend shadowing for 12h then A/B 5% for quality. Add KV-prefix warm and a quick schema contract smoke as part of canary pipeline.

Nina: Launch gates: zero P0s for 12h, p99 <400ms on canaries, quality regression <2% on evals, legal signoff for EU routing. Also enforce per-tenant token cap during early rollout.

Omar: Kill-switch: control-plane has /flags/kill; implement tenant-override flip to fallback-quantized variant + region-force routing. Also add immediate alert to SRE channel.

Zoe: Ops runbook: flip kill, set rollout to 0, run smoke consumer tests, notify customer + oncall. Ill draft and post to #eng-oncall today.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2025-08-02T08:00Z pending runbook + capacity reservation.

Nina: Action list: Omar reserve capacity, Zoe post runbook + add schema smoke, Legal confirm EU VPC pin. Locking plan if no objections.

Omar: +1

Zoe: +1

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduling hold until legal confirms EU routing.
